assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md explicitly references 'Project: TC' and 'Vulnerability issue type ID: 10024' at the top as configuration parameters. All three JQL queries use 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024', consistent with reading these values from the Security Configuration rather than hardcoding arbitrary values.

assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md contains three distinct JQL queries: (1) 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)' for untriaged, (2) 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New' for triaged-but-new, (3) 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, "ON_QA")' for Ready for QA candidates. All three match the required patterns exactly.

assertion_results.text: Results are grouped into three clearly separated lists: Untriaged issues, Triaged but still New issues, and Ready for QA issues
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md organizes results into three numbered, clearly separated sections with horizontal rule dividers: '## 1. Untriaged Issues' (4 issues), '## 2. Triaged but still New' (1 issue), and '## 3. Ready for QA' (1 qualifying issue plus 2 excluded). Each section has its own heading, query, and results table.

assertion_results.text: Each listed issue shows: issue key, status, CVE ID (from labels), summary, and created date
assertion_results.evidence: All listed issues show the five required fields. Untriaged issues in discovery-listing.md show Issue (key), CVE ID, Summary, and Created in table columns, with status communicated via subsection headers ('### Status: New', '### Status: In Progress'). Triaged-but-new section shows Issue, CVE ID, Summary, Created in columns with status conveyed by the section title ('Triaged but still New' = New status). Ready for QA section includes Issue, Status, CVE, Summary, and Created as explicit columns. The status-handling.md file reinforces this by listing Status explicitly for every issue (e.g., 'TC-9001 — Status: New', 'TC-9003 — Status: In Progress').

assertion_results.text: Status-aware handling: New issues (TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004) are presented for full triage, while the In Progress issue (TC-9003) triggers a warning about active work
assertion_results.evidence: status-handling.md shows: TC-9001 (New) — 'Decision: Proceed with full triage (default path)'; TC-9002 (New) — 'Decision: Proceed with full triage (default path)'; TC-9004 (New) — 'Decision: Proceed with full triage (default path)'. TC-9003 (In Progress) — 'Decision: Warn before proceeding' with explicit warning text: 'This issue is already in `In Progress`. It may be actively worked on.' Options are presented to proceed or skip.

assertion_results.text: Ready for QA filtering: TC-9020 appears in Ready for QA (all linked Tasks Done/Closed), TC-9023 is excluded (TC-9025 still In Progress), TC-9026 is excluded (no Depend links)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md shows TC-9020 qualifies as Ready for QA with remediation tasks 'TC-9021 (Done), TC-9022 (Closed)'. TC-9023 is explicitly excluded with reason 'Remediation task TC-9025 still In Progress (TC-9024 is Done)'. TC-9026 is explicitly excluded with reason 'No linked Tasks with Depend type -- no remediation to verify'. The Excluded table and status-handling.md both confirm these filtering decisions with matching rationale.
